description: Research PSGC-to-legislative-district bridge from named administrative locations. No PSGC numeric codes are asserted until a versioned PSGC gazetteer is supplied. A geographic match is NOT evidence of legislative sponsorship or control.

metadata.geographicLevel: city/municipality or barangay; NOT surveyed electoral polygons
warnings: The two BetterGov files are related research artifacts, NOT independent official verification.
Municipality/barangay assignments are provisional and may be stale or duplicated.
Source district identifiers have been matched to the 20th Congress DEO2LEG roster, which is not a legislative boundary proof.
2023 PSGC geometry and later PSGC code versions must be reconciled separately.
No money or project ownership should be allocated from DEO2LEG office associations.
